Job Description
Cyber Security Analyst (AWS/Azure)
We are seeking a detail-oriented Cyber Security Analyst to assess platforms, identify security risks, and help improve the organisation’s security posture across cloud and technology environments. This role has a strong focus on platform security assessments, cloud security posture management (CSPM), and the use of security tools to detect misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, and control gaps. The successful candidate will work closely with engineering, infrastructure, and product teams to provide practical recommendations, support remediation, and promote secure-by-design practices.
Key Responsibilities:
• Conduct security assessments of platforms, applications, and cloud environments to identify risks, misconfigurations, and control weaknesses.

• Review configurations across cloud services, infrastructure, identity, networking, containers, and platform components against security baselines and best practices.
• Analyse findings from security tools and prioritise remediation based on risk, exploitability, and business impact.
• Partner with engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, and product teams to define practical remediation plans and track closure of identified issues.
• Support secure design and architecture reviews for new and existing platforms.
• Validate that security controls are implemented effectively and aligned with organisational policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Assist in developing and maintaining security assessment methodologies, procedures, standards, and reporting templates.
• Prepare clear, concise reports and dashboards summarising risks, trends, exceptions, and remediation progress for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Contribute to continuous improvement of the organisation’s cloud and platform security capabilities, including automation opportunities and tool optimisation.
• Stay current with emerging threats, cloud security risks, and evolving security tooling relevant to platform environments.
This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.
Qualifications
• Experience in cybersecurity, cloud security, platform security, or risk assessment roles.
• Hands-on experience performing technical security assessments across cloud or platform environments.
• Strong understanding of cloud security concepts, including identity and access management, network security, logging and monitoring, encryption, secrets management, and workload protection.
• Experience using CSPM tools and other security technologies such as vulnerability scanners, SIEM, CNAPP, or configuration assessment platforms.

At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely.

Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? About the Opportunity:
We’re looking for a Senior Software Test Engineer to join one of our cross-functional Identity Verification product teams. You’ll have impact on the quality of end-to-end verification journeys spanning web and mobile experiences, backend services and machine-learning-powered products.
Our solutions enable thousands of customers to verify hundreds of millions of users during critical onboarding journeys. This creates unique quality and testing challenges around distributed systems, diverse devices and user conditions and reliable delivery at scale.
About the Team:
You’ll join a team of nine Test Engineers, each embedded within a cross-functional product team. You’ll collaborate with software engineers, product managers, designers and other specialists from early product and technical discussions through release and production feedback.
As Test Engineers, we come together each week to work on shared initiatives that improve tooling, automation, and quality practices across engineering. You’ll have scope to influence both your product team and the wider organization.

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will:
•
Fully own planning, coordinating and executing test and quality-related activities within a cross-functional team;
•
Lead and contribute to the test engineering initiatives that have impact across several engineering teams;
•
Select and apply suitable testing techniques based on a deep understanding of the product from technical and customer perspectives;
•
Build maintainable, developer-friendly test frameworks and automated test suites;
•
Work closely with engineering and product colleagues to clarify acceptance criteria and prioritize quality improvements;
•
Support acceptance testing and combine automation with exploratory testing as required;
•
Mentor colleagues and continuously improve delivery pipelines, release processes, and feedback loops;
•
Advocate for quality and help strengthen the team’s testing culture.
Requirements:
•
5+ years of experience in software testing;
•
Strong test design and automation experience in web, backend or mobile;
•
A solid understanding of testing techniques and quality engineering practices;
•
Strong coding skills in multiple languages (e.g. TypeScript, Java, Ruby, Python);
•
Experience with several test tools and frameworks (e.g. Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, REST Assured);
•
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines;
•
Familiarity with performance testing, containerization and cloud environments;
•
Experience using or building AI-assisted development or testing tools.
Our Tech Stack:
We choose tools pragmatically and do not expect you to know everything in our stack. We value strong engineering fundamentals and a willingness to learn. For testing, we mainly use:
•
Languages: TypeScript, Ruby, Python, Swift, Kotlin
•
Test frameworks: Playwright, RSpec, Pytest, XCUITest, Espresso, k6
•
CI/CD: GitLab, Bitrise
•
Deployment and infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS

Entrust keeps the world moving safely by enabling trusted experiences for identities, payments, and digital infrastructure. With more than 2,800 colleagues, a network of global partners, and customers in over 150 countries, it’s no wonder the world’s most entrusted organizations trust us. Job Description
Registered Nurse - Llandrindod Wells Renal Dialysis Unit
Are you an NMC Registered Nurse seeking an exciting new opportunity to learn specialist skills in renal dialysis nursing?
You may have NHS experience or have worked in the private care sector, but whatever your Nursing background, with the right attitude and aptitude we have an opportunity for you!
What does the role involve?
Being a Dialysis nurse requires commitment and passion along with the skills and competencies to juggle the technical nursing aspect whilst giving holistic care.  You will be working autonomously, responsible for the assessment of care needs and the development, implementation and evaluation of care for dialysis patients with chronic kidney disease or acute kidney injury. You must also be able to take charge of the unit in the absence of the manager, once orientation and competencies are complete.
Llandrindod Wells Unit operates 6 haemodialysis stations, serving up to 24 patients.
This is a full time role of 37.5 hours a week. Current days are working various shifts between 06.30am to 18.30pm Monday to Saturday.
What can we offer you?
Here at Fresenius Medical Care we provide excellent and continuous Training and Development throughout your career, supported by dedicated Clinical Teachers. On joining, you will enroll on our 8 week Fundamental Dialysis Programme, which is accredited by the European Dialysis and Transplant Nurses Association/European Renal Care Association.  Thereafter, we continue to provide training and education opportunities which significantly exceed the CPD hours required for NMC revalidation, and help take your career to the next level.
We offer a competitive salary UPTO £34,759 - Progression through the pay scale will be underpinned by a Knowledge and Skills Framework (KSF) for each role, allowing employees greater career development potential, aligned to in-house training programmes.
Alongside this we offer a wealth of other fantastic benefits listed below:
•            No Sunday or Night Shift Working
•            Company Pension Scheme and Life Assurance
•            33 Days Holiday (inclusive of 8 days bank holiday) increasing with service
•            Christmas Day and New Year’s Day off
•            Overtime (time and a half after completing full-time hours – 150 hours every 4 weeks)
•            Paid Breaks
•            Free Parking, Uniform, Tea & Coffee, Flu Vaccine and Christmas Meal
•            Health Shield – Company paid Health Cash Plan
•            Long Service Vouchers
•            Refer a Friend Scheme (£1000 per referral if successful)
•            Sick Pay
•            Cycle to Work Scheme
•            Sponsorship for training where applicable for career development
•            bhsf RISE - our Health and Wellbeing hub with 24/7 access to GP’s and Counsellors
•            Blue Light Card - discounts online and in-store.
Who is Fresenius Medical Care?
We are the leading provider of dialysis services to the NHS, operating 52 partnership dialysis units that together provide regular dialysis treatment to over 3,800 NHS patients in the UK.  We are part of a global company treating over 344,000 patients worldwide across over 4,100 clinics.
We also operate 42 production sites on all continents to provide dialysis products such as dialysis machines, dialysers and related disposables. 1 in every 2 of all dialysis machines used around the globe are manufactured by Fresenius Medical Care and we are the 3rd largest medical devices company in the world.
For more information please visit Fresenius Medical Care’s provider website: www.nephrocare.co.uk
We are a growing and ambitious company who invests in talent and creates an environment where you can grow too.  Come on our journey with us, see your skills develop and be rewarded for the exceptional care you give!
Nurse posts will be subject to an enhanced DBS Disclosure
Fresenius Medical Care is an equal opportunities employer

Meeting and exceeding performance targets and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Working Together

Collaborating with participants to shift their mindset and build the confidence they need to find and sustain work.
•
Engaging with local employers to identify job opportunities.
•
Signposting participants to internal and external stakeholders to address specific barriers such as health, housing, or financial challenges.

Promoting the Restart Scheme within the community, raising awareness of it's benefits and impact.
Being Fair, Open, and Honest
•
Providing inclusive support and advice to people from all backgrounds.

Bi-annual pay reviews

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital.
Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. harrods.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/harrods_ex.description_excerpt:
We’re currently recruiting for a Bakery Chef de Partie to join our highly successful Bakery Production Team here at Harrods. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced bakery professional to take ownership of a dedicated section within our Production Kitchens, producing exceptional products at scale while supporting the development of junior colleagues and maintaining the world-class standards our customers expect.
You’ll enjoy a competitive salary of £39,252 + tronc*, along with access to our renowned Harrods benefits, including generous discounts across our stores and restaurants.
About the Role
As a Bakery Chef de Partie, you will play a key role in the day-to-day success of our Production Kitchens. Leading your own section, you will organise production, maintain high standards, and ensure bakery products are consistently delivered to specification, on time, and to the exceptional quality expected at Harrods. You will work closely with Sous Chefs and the wider bakery team, helping to create an efficient and supportive environment where colleagues can develop and thrive.
This is a hands-on role where attention to detail, organisation, and a passion for bakery craftsmanship are essential. You will take ownership of your section, support junior chefs, and contribute to maintaining the consistency, safety, and efficiency of the operation.
Your responsibilities will include:
• Leading and organising a dedicated bakery section, ensuring production plans and priorities are delivered effectively.
• Producing high-quality bakery products in line with agreed recipes, specifications, and presentation standards.
• Delegating tasks and providing guidance to Demi Chef de Parties and Commis Chefs, supporting their development and day-to-day performance.
• Monitoring product quality through regular checks, ensuring consistency in flavour, appearance, and overall standards.
• Managing mise en place, production schedules, and recipe documentation to ensure smooth operation of the section.
This is a fully on-site role, working five days out of seven, requiring full flexibility, and availability to work night shifts when required.
About You
You will be a skilled bakery professional with experience working in a fast-paced production or commercial bakery environment. You'll combine strong technical ability with excellent organisation, taking pride in producing high-quality products while supporting the development of those around you.
You will be confident leading your own section, maintaining exceptional standards under pressure, and working collaboratively with colleagues across the kitchen. A positive, solutions-focused approach and a genuine passion for bakery craftsmanship will be key to your success.
You will bring:
• Strong bakery and technical skills, with experience producing high-quality products in a professional kitchen or bakery environment.
• The ability to lead a section confidently and organise workloads effectively.
• Experience coaching or supporting junior chefs and helping to maintain a positive team culture.
• A thorough understanding of food safety, HACCP, hygiene, and compliance standards.
• A calm, collaborative, and solutions-focused approach in a high-volume production environment.
About Us
Harrods is one of the world’s leading luxury department stores and a destination for some of the most sought-after brands from around the globe. Our mission is to make visiting our iconic Knightsbridge store one of the world’s most inspiring shopping experiences.
Behind that experience are our specialist Production Kitchens, where talented teams combine expertise, precision, and creativity to produce exceptional food at scale. Every product is made with care and reflects the quality, attention to detail, and craftsmanship our customers expect from Harrods.
Our Promise to You
Help us make the impossible possible for our customers, and we will do something remarkable for you. You will join a welcoming and supportive environment where you can develop your leadership capabilities, strengthen your technical expertise, and build an exceptional career across the varied specialisms of our business.
Uniquely You
While our job adverts outline the qualities, skills, and experience we are ideally looking for, we believe in potential and value the individual strengths each person brings. If you meet the majority of the requirements and have the experience and enthusiasm to thrive in this role, we encourage you to apply.
At Harrods, we believe the personality and authenticity of our people set us apart. We welcome applications from all cultures, backgrounds, tastes, and experiences, and we are proud to create an environment where people from all walks of life can grow and thrive. What makes you unique makes us exceptional.
To discover more about life at Harrods, search #TogetherHarrods on LinkedIn or follow @togetherharrods on Instagram.
*The amount of tronc you receive will vary and is not guaranteed by either Harrods Ltd or the Troncmaster. However, the Troncmaster will always distribute 100% of the funds available each period in accordance with the Rules, a copy of which will be provided to all members.
